CREATECONTRACT.TITLE: Dala Inkontileka
CREATECONTRACT.INFO: Thumela inkontileka ehlakaniphile kunethiwekhi ngokuthumela i-bytecode yayo ehlanganisiwe. Lona umsebenzi we-core chain - hlola kabili izilungiselelo zakho ze-bytecode kanye negesi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa, ukusetshenziswa akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
CREATECONTRACT.INVALIDBYTECODE: I-Bytecode kumele ibe yintambo ye-hex evumelekile (0-9, a-f) enenani elilinganayo lezinhlamvu
CREATECONTRACT.INCOMPLETEFORM: Sicela ukhethe ikheli lomthumeli, ufake ikhodi ye-byte evumelekile, bese usetha umkhawulo/intengo yegesi evumelekile
CREATECONTRACT.HIGHGASPRICEINFO: Intengo kaphethiloli oyibekile iphakeme ngendlela engavamile. Lokhu kuthunyelwa kungabiza kufika ku:

STAKING.NOTENABLEDINSTR: Ukuze ubambe i-stake kuzodingeka unike amandla i-staking setting staking=1 kufayela lakho le-metrix.conf.
STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINFO: Isikhwama sakho semali sikhiyiwe okwamanje ukuze singafakwa esitobhini.
STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINSTR: Ungaqala ukufaka imali ngokuvula isikhwama sakho semali ukuze ufake imali

MASTERNODES.NOMNOUTPUTS: Akukho okukhiphayo kwe-Masternode okutholiwe. Ukuze usebenzise i-Masternode yendawo thumela izinhlamvu zemali eziyizigidi ezingu-2, 5, 25, 50 noma eziyi-100 ngqo ekhelini lakho le-Masternode bese ulinda iziqinisekiso ezingu-15.

SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: Ungasayina imiyalezo ngamakheli akho ukuze ufakazele ukuthi ungumnikazi wawo. Qaphela ukuthi ungasayini lutho olungacacile, njengoba ukuhlaselwa kwe-phishing kungase kuzama ukukukhohlisa ukuthi usayine ubuwena bakho kubo. Sayina kuphela izitatimende ezinemininingwane ephelele ovumelana nazo.
SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Faka ikheli lokusayina, umlayezo (qinisekisa ukuthi ukopisha ukuhlukana kwemigqa, izikhala, amathebhu, njll. ngqo) kanye nesiginesha ngezansi ukuqinisekisa umlayezo. Qaphela ukuthi ungafundi okuningi ngesiginesha kunalokho okusesigineshaneni ngokwaso, ukuze ugweme ukukhohliswa ukuhlaselwa ngumuntu ophakathi nendawo.

DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO: Siyakwamukela kukhonsoli ye-Metrix Core RPC. Thayipha usizo ukuze uthole umbono jikelele wemiyalo etholakalayo.
DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: ISEXWAYISO: Abakhohlisi bebelokhu besebenza, betshela abasebenzisi ukuthi bathayiphe imiyalo lapha, beba okuqukethwe yisikhwama sabo semali. Ungasebenzisi le khonsoli ngaphandle kokuqonda ngokugcwele imiphumela yomyalo.

REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: Le miyalo yokulungisa ayikwazi ukusebenza uma i-Metrix Core isebenza ngaphandle
REPAIR.INFO: Izinkinobho ezingezansi zizoqala kabusha i-Metrix Core ngezinketho zomugqa womyalo ukulungisa isikhwama semali, ukulungisa izinkinga ngamafayela e-blockchain abonakele noma ukuthengiselana okungekho/okuphelelwe yisikhathi.
REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Ukuzama ukuthola okhiye abayimfihlo kusuka ku-wallet eyonakele.dat.
REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -skena kabusha: Skena kabusha i-blockchain ukuze uthole ukuthengiselana kwesikhwama okungekho.
REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Buyisela ukuthengiselana kusuka ku-blockchain (gcina i-meta-data, isib. umnikazi we-akhawunti)
REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Thuthukisa isikhwama semali sibe yifomethi yakamuva ekuqaleni. (Qaphela: lokhu AKUSIYONA isibuyekezo sesikhwama semali ngokwaso!)
REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Yakha kabusha inkomba ye-blockchain kusuka kumafayela e-blk000??.dat amanje.
REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Ukulanda amafayela e-Metrix blockchain kusuka ku-metrixcoin.com bese uqala kabusha ukufakwa kwakho. Kuye ngokuxhumeka kwenethiwekhi yakho lokhu kungathatha imizuzu eyi-10 kuya emahoreni ambalwa.
REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Susa amafayela akho e-blockchain endawo bese uvumelanisa kabusha kusuka ku-genesis block.
REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Qala kabusha i-Metrix Core uma isivele isebenza noma uqale i-Metrix Core uma ingasebenzi.
REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Susa i-Metrix Core yakho yasendaweni bese uyifaka kabusha kusuka kumaseva e-Metrix.

NETWORK.RESTARTREQUIRED: Ukuqala kabusha kweKlayenti kuyadingeka ukuze kusebenze noma yiziphi izinguquko kulezi zilungiselelo.
NETWORK.SYNCINTERVAL: Ukuthi i-Altitude ibuza kangaki i-daemon (Okuzenzakalelayo: Imizuzwana eyi-10)

BACKUP.ENABLEDINFO: Idala ikhophi yasenqolobaneni entsha yefayela lakho lesikhwama semali ngesikhathi esibekiwe, ngakho-ke ikhophi yakamuva ihlala itholakala uma kukhona okungahambi kahle.
BACKUP.LOCATIONINFO: Lapho kugcinwa khona ama-backup ngokuzenzakalelayo. Okuzenzakalelayo kuya kufolda yokusekelayo ngaphakathi kwesikhombisi sedatha sesikhwama sakho semali.
BACKUP.PRUNEINFO: Ama-backup amadala azenzakalelayo ayasuswa ukuze le folda ingakhuli unomphela - akamuva kuphela angezansi agcinwayo.

EXPLORER.BLOCKEXPLORERINFO: Isayithi livuliwe lapho kubukelwa ukuthengiselana ku-block explorer (isb. chofoza kwesokudla ukuthengiselana > Buka ku-Explorer).
EXPLORER.TOKENDISCOVERYINFO: Isevisi yokufunda kuphela esetshenziselwa ukuthola amathokheni e-MRC20/MRC721 ikheli lesikhwama elisebenzisane nawo. Amabhalansi nobunikazi kuhlala kuqinisekiswa kabusha ngokumelene ne-daemon yakho ngaphambi kokuboniswa noma ukusetshenziswa - lokhu kusetshenziselwa kuphela ukuthola amathokheni okufanele uwahlole.

DEVELOPER.DEVMODEINFO: Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi ihloselwe onjiniyela kuphela. Ukuvumela lokhu kwembula izinketho zokushintsha uxhumano lwe-RPC - abasebenzisi abajwayelekile kufanele bakushiye lokhu.
DEVELOPER.WARNING: Lezi zilungiselelo zenzelwe izinjongo zokuthuthukisa kuphela. Ukuzishintsha kungavimbela isikhwama ukuthi sixhumeke ku-daemon nhlobo - sebenzisa lokhu kuphela uma wazi ukuthi wenzani.
DEVELOPER.RPCHOSTINFO: Ngokuzenzakalelayo i-Altitude ixhuma kwi-daemon eyazilawula yona, kulo mshini (127.0.0.1). Ukudlula lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi ixhume kwi-daemon ehlukile esikhundleni salokho - isibonelo i-remote regtest instance, ngaphandle kwesidingo sokusebenzisa eyodwa endaweni. Uma uxhumano luphumelela, i-Altitude ngeke ilande noma iqale i-daemon yayo yendawo. I-rpcallowip ye-daemon eqondiwe kumele ivumele lokhu kuxhumana, futhi i-rpcuser/rpcpassword engezansi kumele ifane nokucushwa kwayo. Isebenza ngokushesha, akukho ukuqala kabusha okudingekayo.

PROMPT.CLIENTSTOPPEDINFO: Ukuxhumeka kulahlekile ku-Metrix Core. Ungamisa isikhwama semali noma uqale i-Metrix Core yangaphakathi.
PROMPT.ENCRYPTEDCONTENT: Noma yiziphi izipele ozenzile zefayela lakho lesikhwama kufanele zithathelwe indawo yifayela lesikhwama elisanda kukhiqizwa, elibethelwe. Ngenxa yezizathu zokuphepha, izipele zangaphambilini zefayela lesikhwama elingabethelwe ngeke zisebenze ngokushesha nje lapho uqala ukusebenzisa isikhwama esisha, esibethelwe.
PROMPT.CLIENTCLOSEDUNEXPECTEDINFO: Kube nenkinga nge-Metrix Core ebangele ukuthi iphele. Kunconywa ukuthi uhlole ifayela lakho le-debug.log ukuze ubone izinkinga.
PROMPT.CLIENTUNKNOWNERRORINFO: Kube nenkinga yokuxhumana ne-Metrix Core. Kunconywa ukuthi uhlole ifayela lakho le-debug.log ukuze uthole izinkinga.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPFAILEDINFO: Kube nenkinga yokuqalisa kabusha i-Metrix Core. Kunconywa ukuthi uhlole ifayela lakho lelogi ye-Altitude ukuze uthole izinkinga.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPOFFERINFO: I-bootstrap yakamuva iyatholakala engenza i-Metrix Core ibe yamuva ngokushesha. Ukuqhubeka nokuvumelanisa okuvamile kungathatha izinsuku eziningana ukuqeda, njengoba isikhwama sakho semali sidinga ukulanda nokuqinisekisa yonke ibhlogo esiphuthelwe yiyo.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPSPACEINFO: Asikho isikhala sediski esanele sokulanda nokukhipha i-bootstrap. Kuyadingeka: {kuyadingeka}, Kuyatholakala: {mahhala}. Khulula isikhala bese uzama futhi.
PROMPT.STARTUPFAILEDINFO: Kube nephutha ekuqaliseni i-Metrix Core. Kunconywa ukuthi uhlole ifayela lakho lelogi ye-Altitude ukuze uthole izinkinga.
PROMPT.CLIENTINVALIDCONFIGINFO: I-metrix.conf yakho ine-masternode engalungile ezokwenza i-Metrix Core iphume ngokushesha. Sicela uhlole leli fayela.

PROMPT.DAPPSENDINFO: Le sayithi icela ukuthumela ukuthengiselana kwenkontileka kusuka esikhwameni sakho.

PROMPT.DAPPNOWALLET: Ayikwazi ukuxhuma kusayithi - alikho ikheli lesikhwama semali elitholakalayo.

GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Ababusi banesibopho sokuvota ngesabelomali sanyanga zonke kanye nezinguquko ze-blockchain. Ungaba uMbusi ngokufaka isibambiso esifanele kwinkontileka yokuphatha.
GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: Usuzobhalisa njengoMbusi. Lokhu kuzothumela ukuthengiselana okunesibambiso esidingekayo kwinkontileka yokuphatha. Ungayekisa ukubhalisa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Ababusi banesibopho sokuvota ngezabelomali zanyanga zonke kanye nezinguquko ze-blockchain.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: Ukuze uhlale unguMbusi kuzodingeka uhlanganyele okungenani kuvoti elilodwa njalo ezinsukwini ezingama-30.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: Uma kungekho lutho ongavotela kulo ungaqhubeka nokubhalisa kwakho ngesandla ngokuthumela i-ping esebenzayo.
GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAIL: Isimo sakho sokubhalisa kuMbusi sizobonakala uma i-blockchain yakho isivumelanisiwe ngokugcwele.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: I-blockchain ye-Metrix ithuthwa yi-DGP. Kuzodingeka uphume enkontilekeni endala ye-DGP bese uphinda ubhalisele entsha. Uma unoMbusi omdala uzobona inkinobho yokususa ukubhalisa kuleli khasi kuphela.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: Ukubhaliswa okusha kwe-DGP kuzokwenzeka uma sekusebenze i-onchain. I-discord yethu izoqukatha ulwazi lwakamuva ngalokhu.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: Inkinobho engezansi izokhipha inguqulo yakho endala ye-Governor bese ibuyisela isibambiso sakho.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Uma ukususwa kwakho kokubhalisa sekuqediwe, le nketho izonyamalala.

LIST.TITLE: Amathokheni
LIST.EMPTYDETAIL: Ukuphakama ngokuzenzakalela kuhlola i-block explorer amathokheni e-MRC20 kanye ne-MRC721 athunyelwe emakhelini akho, bese kuqinisekisa konke bukhoma ngokumelene ne-node yakho. Ungangeza futhi ithokheni ngesandla uma wazi ikheli layo lenkontileka.
LIST.EMPTYDETAILCHECKINGDISABLED: Ukuhlola amathokheni ngokuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe, ngakho-ke amakheli akho awahlolwa amathokheni. Yivule futhi ngenhla, noma engeza ithokheni ngesandla uma wazi ikheli layo lenkontileka.
LIST.NONENUMERABLETOOLTIP: Leli qoqo alisekeli ukufakwa ohlwini lwezinto ngazinye - okubonisa ukuthi zingaki oziphethe esikhundleni salokho.
LIST.CHECKINGENABLEDTOOLTIP: Ukuhlola amathokheni kuvuliwe - Ukuphakama kuhlola amakheli akho ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze kutholakale amathokheni futhi kuvuselele ibhalansi. Chofoza ukuze uvale.
LIST.CHECKINGDISABLEDTOOLTIP: Ukuhlola amathokheni kuvaliwe - chofoza ukuze uvule futhi.
LIST.CHECKINGDISABLEDNOTICE: Ukuhlola amathokheni ngokuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe. Amakheli akho awaskeniwe ukuthola amathokheni futhi izilinganiso ngeke zibuyekezwe. Usengangeza ithokheni ngesandla.

ADDTOKEN.TITLE: Engeza ithokheni
ADDTOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Faka ikheli lenkontileka lethokheni le-MRC20 noma le-MRC721 ukuze ulifake ohlwini lwakho lwethokheni.
ADDTOKEN.NOTFOUND: Leli kheli alibonakali liyinkontileka yethokheni ye-MRC20 noma ye-MRC721 esekelwayo.
